title: Not what I was looking for
text: Not what I was looking for. My mug measures 4" and this cover just barely fits on, I have to be careful it covers all the mug. The one I have already,  I can just plop it on the mug without wondering if it's covered. Also I put it on the mug to try it out and when I lifted it up,  the butterfly came right off and it's  really difficult to put it back on.?
